## Highlights
### New
- Spaces can start from a Neutral look: a plain gray sidebar with a fine grain that goes light or dark with the system. A Space's text color can follow the system's appearance too.
### Improved
- Connected tools can search history, use search providers, and open windows in allowed Spaces, and delete an address from a Space’s history once you agree, while private tabs remain inaccessible.
### Fixed
- The sidebar no longer slides back out under a pointer that is just resting at the screen edge, such as one left there by Universal Control. It reveals when you move the pointer to the edge.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
